turns.user_utterance: I was trying to purchase something at the store today and my card has been declined.  Why has this happened?
turns.assistant_response: I’m sorry that happened. It sounds like your card payment was declined—this is usually caused by things like insufficient funds, the card needing verification, merchant restrictions, or a temporary network/security block. Can you tell me whether you got a decline message at the checkout (and the exact wording, if you remember)?
